title: Flow diagrams, state diagrams and context maps

videos.script: A ticket is never just sold. It is held, then paid, then boarded, or refunded, or it expires while the passenger hesitates. {{title}} This lesson draws three things the boxes of lesson 3 cannot show. {{three}} First, a flow. What happens, step by step, and who does each step, when a passenger cancels a trip. {{flow}} Second, a state machine. Every state a ticket can be in, and every event that moves it. This is the drawing that finds bugs, because it makes you ask what happens to a ticket in every state, for every event. {{state}} Third, a context map. Not the services, but the models, and which team has to adapt when another one changes. {{map}} Each one answers a question the others cannot. By the end you will know which question you are being asked.
